processing: Speech recognition and supported formatting run on the Mac after model setup.
configurable_cloud_path: No cloud speech mode. Optional direct agent handoff sends the finished specification, not microphone audio.
offline: Dictate works after the speech-model download; paid continuation works after one Gumroad key check.
retention: IraVoice says its servers receive no audio, transcript, selected text, vocabulary, or repository context; the Mac app has no product telemetry or cloud transcript history.
account: No account or card for the full trial. Paid use relies on a Gumroad license key stored in Keychain.
caveat: IraVoice publishes this matrix. Verify its product claims against the linked privacy page and treat the dataset as documentation research, not an independent audit.

processing: On-device or on Apple servers depending on language and the indicator shown in Keyboard Settings.
configurable_cloud_path: The processing path is configuration-dependent rather than a separate third-party provider selector.
offline: Available without a connection only for configurations Apple marks as on-device.
retention: Apple says server-processed Dictation is not stored unless Improve Siri & Dictation is enabled; request and transcript metadata have separate documented handling.
account: Included with supported macOS. Apple documents device-generated identifiers and separate Apple Account-related service boundaries.
caveat: Do not assume every language or Mac configuration uses the same processing path. Check the current Keyboard Settings disclosure on the actual Mac.

processing: Google’s reviewed Mac launch sources describe the current native macOS feature set as on-device, including dictation, Voice Edit, and local audio or video file transcription.
configurable_cloud_path: The current Mac product page says Google AI Edge Eloquent can optionally access Google Workspace data such as Gmail to generate a vocabulary list of unique words.
offline: Google’s June 3, 2026 launch announcement says the current native macOS feature set is fully offline.
retention: The reviewed Mac sources establish on-device processing and offline use, but do not publish a separate desktop retention or telemetry statement for every Mac feature.
account: The reviewed Mac sources document a direct Mac download and optional Workspace or Gmail vocabulary access, but do not clearly state whether a Google account is otherwise required for the core desktop workflow.
platform: Native macOS app; the current FAQ says English only.
caveat: The current product-page FAQ still contains older desktop-evaluation wording that conflicts with the dated launch announcement and direct Mac DMG. Use the launch post and current Mac download as platform truth, and do not transfer iOS-only cloud-feature wording to the Mac app.

processing: Initial speech recognition uses local Whisper on a compatible Apple-silicon Mac.
configurable_cloud_path: Optional Pro sends the text transcript—but not audio—to OpenAI for cleanup and formatting.
offline: Basic local transcription works offline. Pro cleanup requires a connection.
retention: The privacy policy separates local audio processing from optional transcript transfer and also discloses performance and crash telemetry.
account: A paid license key is required; optional Pro is a separate recurring service.
platform: Apple-silicon Mac; current help asks for macOS Sonoma 14.4 or later.
caveat: The local claim covers initial transcription. Enabling Pro changes the transcript path even though microphone audio remains local.

processing: Local Whisper or Parakeet, user-key providers, or managed hosted models depending on the active mode.
configurable_cloud_path: Yes. Model, AI Instructions, provider, optional context, and output actions can change the data path.
offline: Local models work offline. Local Only Mode blocks outbound access while permitting local and localhost models.
retention: Retention depends on local, managed, or bring-your-own provider paths; Spokenly also documents history and optional audio replay.
account: Local and BYOK paths are available without a paid Pro plan; managed services and sync features can introduce account boundaries.
platform: macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS, with features varying by platform.
caveat: “Spokenly” is not one fixed architecture. Record the active mode, provider, context sources, history setting, and output action.

processing: Raycast says recorded audio is sent to its speech-to-text partner for transcription.
configurable_cloud_path: Dictation is a connected Raycast AI feature; optional App Context and later AI actions can add separate data.
offline: No documented offline speech-to-text path for Raycast Dictation.
retention: Raycast says it does not retain recorded audio after the transcription request; Dictation history is stored locally on the Mac.
account: Raycast AI plan and account controls apply to the connected feature.
platform: Raycast for macOS on supported Macs.
caveat: No post-request audio retention does not mean on-device transcription. Local history and any later AI action are separate boundaries.

processing: Wispr says transcription always happens in the cloud.
configurable_cloud_path: The speech path is cloud-based. Privacy Mode and Private Cloud Sync settings change retention, not the location of transcription.
retention: Wispr says Privacy Mode with Private Cloud Sync disabled provides zero retention; other settings can retain data for history or sync.
account: A connected product account and plan participate in the service.
platform: Current desktop and mobile platforms supported by Wispr Flow.
caveat: Zero retention is a storage policy for the cloud path, not a claim that microphone audio never leaves the device.

processing: Superwhisper documents offline, on-device transcription for its local speech path.
configurable_cloud_path: Optional cloud models and browser or assistant tools are separate connected paths.
offline: The documented local transcription path works offline after required model setup.
retention: For offline transcription, Superwhisper says audio is not uploaded. Connected features follow their selected service boundaries.
account: App licensing applies; optional connected providers or tools can introduce separate credentials and terms.
platform: Mac, Windows, and iPhone support is currently advertised.
caveat: The offline claim belongs to local transcription. Do not transfer it to an optional cloud model, browser tool, or assistant feature.

processing: MacWhisper documents local transcription by default, including a local dictation path.
configurable_cloud_path: Optional cloud transcription, assistant, and third-party AI provider features can change the path.
offline: Supported local models and dictation can work offline after model setup.
retention: Local workflows keep transcription on the Mac; retention for optional providers depends on the chosen external service.
account: Free and paid app tiers exist; optional provider features can require separate keys or accounts.
platform: macOS, with model performance depending on Mac hardware.
caveat: MacWhisper includes broader file, meeting, assistant, and provider workflows. The active model and feature determine the actual boundary.

processing: Local models are the default; users can configure cloud transcription and enhancement providers.
configurable_cloud_path: Yes. The active mode can select cloud transcription, enhancement, context, auto-send, or a custom command.
offline: Local model workflows can work offline; configured cloud providers require a connection.
retention: Local defaults keep speech processing on the Mac. Optional provider retention follows the provider selected by the user.
account: GPLv3 source can be self-built; the compiled app uses a commercial license, and optional providers use user credentials.
caveat: The active model, provider, context source, mode, and output command determine the boundary; an open-source codebase does not make every configuration local.

processing: Core dictation, custom vocabulary, formatting, and file transcription run on the Mac.
configurable_cloud_path: Optional rewrite providers require a connection and send selected text to the provider the user chooses.
offline: Core dictation works offline after required app and model setup; optional rewrites do not.
retention: The App Store listing describes on-device core processing. Apple may receive purchase and receipt-verification traffic.
account: Distributed through the Mac App Store, so Apple purchase and receipt boundaries apply.
caveat: The on-device claim covers core dictation. Enabling a rewrite provider changes the selected-text path, and App Store licensing still creates an Apple network boundary.

processing: The publisher documents local Parakeet transcription and local smart formatting.
configurable_cloud_path: No cloud speech or formatting provider is disclosed for the documented workflow.
offline: The documented speech path works offline after the model download.
retention: History is stored locally; the publisher says audio and transcripts are not transmitted.
account: No product account is required. Purchase and license delivery use Gumroad.
platform: macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
caveat: This is a review of publisher documentation. A “100% offline” statement does not independently verify the current binary or every licensing request.

processing: WhisperKit runs locally on Apple silicon; the publisher says audio is processed in memory.
configurable_cloud_path: No cloud speech or cleanup path is documented for the current core product.
offline: The documented speech path works offline after model setup.
retention: The publisher says audio is never saved or transmitted.
account: No product account is required; Pro uses an emailed license key.
platform: macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon.
caveat: The product page does not establish an independent audit or guarantee that every future feature shares the same boundary.

processing: Speech recognition runs locally using a model downloaded to the Mac.
configurable_cloud_path: The documented current product does not offer an AI rewrite or cloud speech path.
offline: Dictation works offline after the roughly 3 GB model download.
retention: The app does not upload audio or transcripts; the privacy policy separately discloses account, license, device, billing, and consented website-analytics data.
account: The website version uses an account and recurring license; Apple handles payment and account boundaries for the App Store version.
platform: macOS 14 or later; Intel Macs are supported with slower documented performance.
caveat: The app-level no-analytics claim should not be transferred to the website, account, license, billing, or optional analytics boundaries.

processing: Speech recognition runs locally using supported on-device engines.
configurable_cloud_path: Optional AI features can use local providers or send transcript text—not microphone audio—to a selected cloud provider.
offline: Local speech recognition works offline after required model setup.
retention: The publisher says it does not collect audio or transcript content; optional anonymous telemetry can be disabled, and meeting retention is controlled locally.
account: No product account is required for the documented app workflow.
platform: macOS 14.2 or later on Apple silicon.
caveat: The local speech claim does not extend to a cloud AI provider the user selects or to externally downloaded source content.

processing: WhisperKit transcription runs locally on Apple silicon.
configurable_cloud_path: No cloud dependency is documented for the current transcription workflow.
offline: Transcription works offline after required model setup.
retention: The product page says transcription history is stored locally.
account: A one-time Polar license key can activate up to three Macs; no recurring core plan is advertised.
platform: macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
caveat: The public product page does not document an independent audit or every licensing and network-metadata boundary.

processing: Users can select local WhisperKit or Parakeet models, or optional OpenAI and Groq cloud transcription with their own key.
configurable_cloud_path: Yes. Cloud mode sends recordings directly to the selected provider; the publisher says no Sotto server sits in the middle.
offline: Local models work offline after download. Cloud providers require a connection.
retention: Local-mode audio stays on the Mac. Cloud-mode retention and processing follow the selected provider, while saved history remains a separate local setting.
account: Purchase uses an emailed license key for up to three Macs; optional cloud providers use the user’s credentials.
platform: macOS 13 or later, with Apple silicon recommended.
caveat: The active local or cloud model determines the speech boundary. Cloud-provider retention and local history must be evaluated separately.

processing: Apple SpeechAnalyzer streams speech-to-text on the Mac; Smart Cleanup and “Hey Megaphone” use Apple’s on-device Foundation Models, with deterministic Basic cleanup as fallback.
configurable_cloud_path: No cloud speech, cleanup, assistant, or provider path is documented for the current product.
offline: The documented core path works on-device after the required app and Apple speech-model setup; the selected speech model downloads on first use.
retention: The official site and repository say recorded audio, transcripts, Dictionary data, memory, recent-text context, and active app or window-title context stay on the Mac; Megaphone has no product server.
account: No product account, subscription, transcription API, or API key is required. The app and source are free under the MIT license.
platform: macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.
caveat: This is documentation and source-repository research, not packet inspection or binary verification. Releases are signed but not notarized, and the publisher documents a quarantine-clearing or Open Anyway installation step.
